name: Edelweis
kurzbeschreibung:
**Edelweiss in Reutte**

Discover the **Edelweiss** in its natural habitat in the **Lechtal Alps** near **Reutte**. This rare and protected alpine flower is a symbol of the high mountains and can be admired in its full glory during the short summer months.

**Reutte**, the gateway to the **Lechtal Alps**, invites you to explore the breathtaking landscapes of **Tirol**. Whether on a hike through the **Hochtannberg** or a scenic drive along the **Lechtal Valley**, you’ll encounter the **Edelweiss** in its most beautiful setting.

**Tip:** Always respect nature—admire the **Edelweiss** from a distance and never pick it, as it is protected by law.

Experience the magic of the **Edelweiss** in **Reutte** and let yourself be enchanted by the untouched beauty of the **Tirol** Alps.
